prologue.title: Prologue
lines: Euthalassa. Every submariner has heard of
the city of Euthalassa. A safe haven for
any submariner brave enough to try finding it

prologue.title: Prologue
lines: You are a privateer who scrimped up enough
scraps to finally purchase your very own
state-of-the-art submarine - the Herta.

prologue.title: Prologue
lines: After a long travel, you find yourself in
front of the first of many goal cities in your
attempt to find the hidden city of Eutalassa.

prologue.title: Prologue
lines: The computer of the Herta slowly whirs to life.
Looks like the routine system update is complete.
Sounds of drives and analog devices click.

prologue.title: Tutorial
lines: The computer of eventually beeps to life.
"Update complete. Main systems rebooted."
"Would you like a tour of the Herta OS?"

prologue.title: Prologue
lines: The controls of the Herta are all too
familiar to you. Luckily, you know that
you can press H to bring up the manual again!

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Welcome to the Herta class submarine.
Right click on the world map panel to move.
Press the spacebar to ping the radar.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Moving consumes fuel. Failure to provide
sufficient fuel will cause all systems,
including life support to cease operations.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Pinging returns your surroundings. However,
the local fauna have shown agression to sonar
eminating from submarines.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Exercise caution, as the wildlife also
appear to have the ability to track last
known ping locations.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Finally, if you ever need to revisit the overworld
system tutorial, press the ? button at the top
right to bring it up again.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Thank you for using HertaOS!
This covers all there is to know about
travelling. Have a very safe day.

exit_prompt.title: Abandon ship?
lines: Are you sure you want to exit to the main menu?
You can't forever ignore the siren
calls of the depths...
